item.title: [CNBC Economy] 沙特调整愿景2030支出，应对经济与安全双重压力
item.description:
CNBC Economy · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

沙特经济大臣费萨尔·易卜拉欣对CNBC表示，沙特正从“不惜一切代价投入和交付”转向“以合理成本投入和交付”。

英文原文（Original）

The Kingdom is moving from "spending and delivery at any cost" to "spending and delivery at the right cost," Economic Minister Faisal Alibrahim told CNBC.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] 重新想象食品创新：低科技的社会实践同样关键
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

围绕食品的一些最重要的创新，并不是高科技的科学突破，而是低科技的社会实践与社会关系，比如新的合作方式和责任分配方式。要修复我们已然失灵的食物体系，我们必须要求这些实践中最优秀的部分得到尊重和投入。

英文原文（Original）

Some of the most significant innovations surrounding food are not high-tech scientific advances but low-tech social practices and relations, such as new ways of cooperating and distributing responsibility. To fix our broken food systems, we must demand that the best of these practices receive respect and investment.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] 枪支回购有效，但并非如我们所想
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

一些人认为，除非枪支回购能降低凶杀率，否则毫无意义。但针对墨西哥城枪支回购项目的新研究表明，这类措施能够切实减少非致命伤害——这类伤害比凶杀更为常见，且可能带来严重的心理及其他长期健康后果。

英文原文（Original）

Some argue that gun buybacks are pointless unless they lower homicide rates. But new research into Mexico City’s gun-buyback program suggests that such measures can meaningfully reduce nonlethal injuries, which are more common than homicides, and can have serious psychological and other lasting health consequences.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] 全球残障议程的未来走向
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

曾经有一个看似合理的假设：把残障人士纳入现有的多边体系，就能让他们从各项成果中受益。但如今，这个假设已经不成立了。要想取得更好的结果，就需要向残障运动学习，学会如何把多元、可及、关怀和参与放在议程的核心位置。

英文原文（Original）

The once-reasonable assumption that integrating disabled people into the existing multilateral order would help them benefit from the results being delivered no longer holds. Achieving better outcomes requires learning from disability movements about how to put diversity, access, care, and participation at the center of the agenda.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] AI矿产争夺战：绿色转型的公平之路还能走多远？
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

为了给AI基础设施备足铜、铝、锂、钴等关键矿产，一场全球抢矿大战正在上演。这股热潮有可能让绿色转型过程中好不容易推动起来的负责任采矿实践出现倒退。但换个角度看，它也可能成为一个契机，帮助矿产生产国走上可持续发展的道路。

英文原文（Original）

The scramble to secure huge amounts of copper, aluminum, lithium, cobalt, and other minerals for AI infrastructure risks undoing the progress made, as part of the green transition, toward more responsible mining practices. But it could also be an opportunity to support sustainable development in producer countries.

item.title: [CNBC Economy] 中国工厂利润回暖，但AI热潮只让部分企业受益
item.description:
CNBC Economy · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

中国经济正以两种速度运行：与人工智能相关的制造业和出口拉动增长，而消费和房地产投资则相对滞后。

英文原文（Original）

China's economy has been running at two speeds, with AI-related manufacturing and exports powering growth while consumption, real estate investment lag.

item.title: [CNBC Economy] 美国加征关税施压贸易伙伴，催促尽快签协议
item.description:
CNBC Economy · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

美国计划对14个贸易伙伴发起新一轮关税攻势，同时向部分国家抛出橄榄枝：只要与华盛顿达成贸易协议，就能享受较低税率。

The U.S. planned a fresh tariff salvo on 14 trading partners, while offering some countries lower rates if they secure trade deals with Washington.
